nodes.summary: Let $k$ and $n$ be natural numbers. nodes.title: Callan sequences

nodes.summary: A partition $P$ of $\{1, \dots, n\}$ is basic when its blocks can be listed without repetition as $B_1, \dots, B_k$ with $|B_1| \ge |B_2| \ge \dots \ge |B_k|$ so that $B_1 \cup \dots \cup B_i = \{1, \dots, |B_1| + \dots + |B_i|\}$ for every $i$ with $1 \le i \le k$.
nodes.title: Basic set partition

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number. A finite sequence $(B_1, \dots, B_m)$ of subsets of $\{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$ is a merging-free partition when the sets $B_i$ are nonempty, pairwise disjoint and cover $\{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$; their minima increase strictly, $\min B_1 < \min B_2 < \dots < \min B_m$; and $\max B_i > \min B_{i+1}$ for every $i < m$.
nodes.title: Merging-free partitions

nodes.summary: For a finite set $V$, a list $(B_1, \dots, B_k)$ of finite sets is an ordered set partition (set composition) of $V$ when every block $B_i$ is nonempty and contained in $V$, the blocks are pairwise disjoint, and $B_1 \cup \dots \cup B_k = V$.
nodes.title: Ordered set partitions of a finite set

nodes.summary: Fix $k \ge 0$. can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
